name: California statutory deadline, retention and tax checks
standard: California Civil Code §§ 8204, 8412, 8414, 8460, 8811, 8812; Public Contract Code §§ 7107, 7201; 18 CCR 1521; Labor Code § 1771
edition: Statutes as in force on 1 November 2026
description: Runs the checks the statutory engines compute from the California tables: retention above the public or private 5 percent cap, an estimate priced at the 7.25 percent statewide base as if it were the jobsite rate, an installed item not classified as a material or a fixture, a public work carrying only a federal wage determination, and every preliminary notice, lien recording and retention release deadline, which turns into an error the day after it passes.
